title: Check in has a door in the Space Manage menu: Offerings & Money lists it, and it opens the door code, the NFC link and Regulars

source.ref: Owner report 2026-10-20 ('where the fuck is check in'): no tab led to the Check in panel. ADR-1788

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. The old space.checkin row was retired (LIVE-226) but its ?panel=checkin panel stayed, so the only way in was a typed URL. A new row space.regulars (label Check in) sits in the Offerings and money box under a new 'At the door' group and opens that panel inline. space.checkin stays retired.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const miss=[];if(!/id: 'space\.regulars', label: 'Check in'/.test(r('lib/admin/modules/space-modules.ts')))miss.push('no Check in row');if(!/'space\.regulars': 'checkin'/.test(r('lib/spaces/surface-hrefs.ts')))miss.push('row does not open the panel');if(!/space\.regulars/.test(r('lib/admin/modules/space-hub.ts')))miss.push('row not in a hub group');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-949: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
